title: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
amount: €8,000 gross per year + full fee exemption
eligible: Open to international (non-Italian) students applying to an English-taught degree programme at the University of Padua. Applicants must not hold Italian citizenship (unless dual), must not be resident in Italy, and must hold a foreign secondary school diploma (Bachelor's) or foreign degree (Master's).
desc: The University of Padua offers up to 68 scholarships to brilliant international students attending an English-taught Bachelor's or Master's degree. The scholarship is €8,000 gross per year plus full exemption from student fees (beneficiaries pay only the regional fee and revenue stamp). Awarded on academic merit; applying to the degree programme automatically enters you into the selection. The scholarship is paid in two instalments of €4,000 gross per academic year.

title: Padua Full Fee Waivers for International Students
amount: 100 full tuition fee waivers
duration: 1 academic year, renewable up to 3 years
eligible: International (non-Italian) students enrolling in an English-taught degree programme at the University of Padua. Must not hold Italian citizenship (unless dual), must not already be resident in Italy, and must hold a foreign diploma.
desc: The University of Padua offers 100 full tuition fee waivers to outstanding international students enrolling in an English-taught degree programme. Beneficiaries pay only the regional tax and stamp duty and are exempt from the second and third instalments of tuition fees. The waiver is offered for one academic year and may be renewed (2nd year requires at least 25 credits by 10 August; 3rd year for Bachelor's requires 80 credits by 10 August of the second year). Selection is based on the previous academic record.

title: Padua Departmental Scholarships for International Students
amount: €8,000 pre-tax per year + fee exemption
eligible: International students admitted to the listed English-taught degree programmes at participating Padua departments (FISPPA, ICEA, DII, DM, DIMED, DPSS, SPGI, DISLL, TeSAF).
desc: Several departments of the University of Padua offer scholarships for international students in their English-taught degree programmes, including Psychology, Social Sciences and Digital Data, Environmental/Water and Geological Risk/Energy/Materials/Electrical/Aerospace Engineering, Computational Finance, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Mathematics, Medicine and Surgery, Applied Child and Adolescent Psychology, Human Rights and Multi-level Governance, European and Global Studies, Communication Strategies, and Forest Sciences. Each scholarship is €8,000 pre-tax per year plus exemption from student fees.

title: MAECI Scholarships at the University of Padua
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
amount: €900 per month
eligible: International students and Italian students residing permanently abroad (IRE), from the MAECI beneficiary-country list, applying to a Master's, PhD or research project at the University of Padua. Age limit: 28 (Master's), 30 (PhD), 40 (research).
lang: B2 CEFR in Italian (Italian-taught courses) or English (English-taught courses)
desc: The Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI) provides scholarships for international students and Italian students residing permanently abroad to carry out study, training and/or research programmes at Italian institutions. At the University of Padua this covers Master's degrees, PhD courses and research projects. The scholarship consists of €900 per month for 6 to 9 months. Application is made online through the Ministry's website (studyinitaly.esteri.it), and you must also enrol in the chosen degree programme at the University of Padua.

title: Invest Your Talent in Italy — University of Padua
provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
amount: €1,000 net per month for 9 months
eligible: Citizens of Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ethiopia, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Iran, Kazakhstan, Mexico, People's Republic of China, Republic of Korea, Tunisia, Turkey and Vietnam, holding a Bachelor's degree and applying to an eligible English-taught Master's at the University of Padua.
desc: Invest Your Talent in Italy supports international students enrolling in an English-taught Master's degree in Engineering/High Technologies, Design/Architecture or Economics/Management at the University of Padua. The scholarship includes €1,000 net per month for 9 months (renewable for the second year subject to achieving at least 30 ECTS by 20 July), tuition fee waivers, living expenses and support services, plus a mandatory 3-month traineeship at a major Italian company.

title: Galilean School of Higher Studies Scholarships for International Students
amount: €2,500 scholarship + free room and board + flight reimbursement up to €1,500
eligible: International students holding (or planning to obtain) a Bachelor's degree, admitted or eligible for a Master's degree programme at the University of Padua, and not yet 25 years old at the time of application.
desc: The Galilean School of Higher Education (Scuola Galileiana di Studi Superiori) is the University of Padua's school of excellence. International students admitted to the school receive free room and board at university residences and canteens, a scholarship of €2,500, a return flight ticket to/from their country of origin (up to €1,500) per academic year, reimbursement of documented expenses, language courses and personalised tutoring. Application window is typically 25 March to 31 May.

title: Sapienza International Post-degree Scholarship
amount: €1,290 per month
eligible: Sapienza Master's degree (or single-cycle) graduates, 28 years old or younger at the announcement of the call, applying to pursue third-cycle study or postgraduate training at an international university institution outside Italy. For non-Italian citizens the host institution must be in a country other than their country of origin.
desc: The International Post-degree Scholarship supports participation in third-cycle study programmes or postgraduate advanced training activities at international university-level institutions outside Italy. Call 2026 awards 400 months of scholarships at €1,290 per month, with duration of 6 to 12 months. Applications must be submitted by 16 September 2026. The call is published every year in April/May on the Amministrazione trasparente portal.

title: Sapienza International Thesis Scholarship
amount: €2,821 gross for the whole internship
eligible: Sapienza students enrolled at least in the first year of a two-year Master's degree, or in the last/second-to-last year of a single-cycle degree, who want to conduct part of their thesis research abroad.
desc: The International Thesis Scholarship supports Sapienza students who want to conduct part of their thesis research abroad at institutions, companies or international organisations of higher scientific and cultural level. The research must last at least two consecutive months and the amount for the whole internship is €2,821 gross. Each faculty issues its own call; applications are submitted at the faculty presidencies.

title: Sapienza IUPALS Scholarship for Palestinian Students
amount: Fee exemption + accommodation, meals and health insurance
eligible: Students residing in the Palestinian Territories applying to an English-taught Bachelor's degree at Sapienza (Classics, Global Humanities, Business Sciences, Economics and Finance).
desc: IUPALS (Italian Universities for Palestinian Students) provides scholarships allowing students residing in the Palestinian Territories to pursue their studies in Italy. Sapienza awards 2 scholarships including exemption from university fees, accommodation, meals and health insurance costs. Eligible English-taught Bachelor's degrees: Classics, Global Humanities, Business Sciences, Economics and Finance. Application via the Universitaly portal, Infostud registration, then emailing documents to dirittoallostudio@uniroma1.it (passport, secondary school diploma, transcripts, English B2 certification).

title: Sapienza Scholarships for Meritorious Students from Italian and International Universities
amount: €4,300 per year (11 scholarships) or €3,000 per year (85 scholarships)
eligible: EU and non-EU graduates (excluding Italian citizens) for the 'Don't Miss Your Chance' call (requires SAT certificate); graduates of other Italian universities with a grade between 105/110 and 110/110 cum laude enrolling in a Master's at Sapienza for the 'Wanted the Best' call.
desc: Sapienza awards two-year scholarships to meritorious students: 'Don't Miss Your Chance' awards 11 scholarships of €4,300 per year to EU and non-EU graduates (excluding Italian citizens) who hold a SAT certificate, with exemption from tuition fees; 'Wanted the Best' awards 85 scholarships of €3,000 per year to students who obtained a first degree at other Italian universities with a grade of 105/110 to 110/110 cum laude and enrol in a Master's degree at Sapienza.

title: Unibo Action 1 & 2 Scholarships for International Students
amount: €11,000 gross study grant (Action 2) or full tuition fee waiver (Action 1)
eligible: International students enrolling in a first-cycle (Bachelor's) or second-cycle (Master's) degree programme at the University of Bologna. Unibo Action 2 study grants are assigned on the basis of SAT and GRE tests.
desc: The University of Bologna offers international students two merit-based opportunities: Unibo Action 2 study grants of €11,000 gross per academic year and Unibo Action 1 tuition fee waivers. Both are assigned on the basis of SAT and GRE test scores. The call for applications is published annually; application for the scholarship and admission to the degree programme are separate procedures, and grants are generally not cumulative.

title: University of Tokyo Fellowship for International Students
amount: ¥200,000 per month
duration: standard period of study of the graduate programme
eligible: Outstanding self-funded international students pursuing degree programmes (Master's, PhD, professional degrees) at the University of Tokyo, or research students (up to one year).
desc: The University of Tokyo Fellowship is a research grant-in-aid established in 2004 to support outstanding, self-funded international students pursuing degrees at the University and to promote the enrolment of exceptional international students. Recipients are awarded ¥200,000 per month for the standard period of study of their graduate programme (up to one year for research students). In AY 2025, 44 new recipients were selected (110 graduate students total). Applications are submitted through the applicant's affiliated or prospective Graduate School.

title: University of Tokyo Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
amount: MEXT standard stipend (tuition + monthly allowance)
eligible: International students applying through the Japanese embassy/consulate (embassy recommendation) or the university (university recommendation). At UTokyo, categories are Research students (Master's, Doctorate, Professional Degree) and Undergraduate students.
desc: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship allows students to study at the University of Tokyo with a scholarship from the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology. UTokyo accepts students as Research students (Master's, Doctorate, Professional Degree programmes) and Undergraduate students. Applications are made through Japanese embassies (embassy recommendation) or the university (university recommendation) before matriculation. Refer to the Application Guideline for the year you are applying to.

title: Kyoto iUP Scholarship (International Undergraduate Program)
amount: Full admission and tuition fee waivers + monthly allowance up to ¥120,000 during preparatory course
eligible: International students admitted to the Kyoto iUP (International Undergraduate Program), a 4.5-year English-based program taught in Japanese at Kyoto University.
desc: The Kyoto iUP is Kyoto University's International Undergraduate Program combining a six-month preparatory course with a four-year undergraduate degree taught in Japanese. Scholarships include full admission fee waivers and full or partial tuition fee waivers for four-and-a-half years, plus a monthly allowance of up to ¥120,000 for all students during the six-month preparatory course. After enrolment, merit-based monthly allowances from supporting companies and organizations are available to eligible students.

title: Kyoto University Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
amount: MEXT standard stipend (tuition + monthly allowance)
eligible: International students in the seven MEXT categories, selected overseas via embassy recommendation or at Kyoto University via university recommendation.
desc: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship, funded by the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, is available to seven categories of students at Kyoto University. Most MEXT scholarship students at Kyoto University earned their scholarship through embassy recommendation. Applications should be made before matriculation, either through a Japanese embassy or consulate (embassy recommendations) or through the host university in Japan (university recommendations).

title: Nagoya University Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
amount: ¥117,000–¥242,000 per month depending on level
eligible: International students at Nagoya University in the MEXT categories: undergraduate, research students, non-degree students, Master's course, Doctoral course, Young Leaders' Program.
desc: The Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship at Nagoya University provides monthly stipends (2019 schedule): ¥117,000 for undergraduate students, ¥143,000 for research students, ¥144,000 for Master's course, ¥145,000 for Doctoral course, and ¥242,000 for Young Leaders' Program students, with an additional ¥2,000–3,000 for designated regions (¥3,000 in Nagoya city). Stipends are deposited by JASSO into students' postal savings accounts. Extension of tenure is possible for those proceeding to a higher degree, subject to MEXT GPA requirements.

title: SNU Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) for Undergraduate Students
amount: Full tuition (8 semesters) + ₩1,200,000/month + airfare + Korean language training
duration: up to 8 semesters + 1 year Korean training
eligible: International applicants who wish to apply for undergraduate programmes at Seoul National University. Applications are submitted to Korean embassies in applicants' countries, which make the first selection; NIIED makes the final selection.
desc: The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) at Seoul National University covers full tuition for 8 semesters, a monthly allowance of ₩1,200,000 (including living expenses, textbooks, insurance premiums and TOPIK scholarships), one economy round-trip airfare, and one year of Korean language training (mandatory — students must achieve TOPIK grade 3 within a year to enter the degree programme). Application period is September; selection is made through Korean embassies and NIIED.

title: SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF)
amount: Full tuition (6 semesters) + ₩1,500,000–2,000,000/month + airfare + insurance
eligible: Faculty members of a major university in a developing country WITHOUT a Ph.D. degree, newly admitted to SNU as Ph.D. students (priority to faculty from major universities in developing countries in Asia, Africa, South America). Approximately 8 recipients per semester.
desc: The SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF) supports faculty members of major universities in developing countries who are newly admitted as Ph.D. students at Seoul National University. Benefits include full tuition exemption for up to 6 semesters, living expenses of ₩1,500,000–2,000,000 per month for 3-4 years, round-trip economy airfare, Korean language training, and National Health Insurance fee reimbursement. Apply for the scholarship together with the online admission application.

title: SNU Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)
amount: Full tuition (4 semesters) + minimum ₩500,000/month
eligible: Non-Korean applicants from eligible countries, enrolled or graduated, who are accepted into SNU and applied to a designated college/school participating in the GSFS Program. Approximately 20 recipients per semester.
desc: The Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) at Seoul National University provides full tuition exemption for up to 4 semesters and a living expense allowance of at least ₩500,000 per month (varying by major) to approximately 20 non-Korean graduate students per semester. Applicants must apply for the scholarship at the same time as the online admission application. The list of eligible countries and participating colleges differs every semester.

title: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
amount: Full study and living costs during the Master's degree
eligible: Excellent Master's students (no MAS) at ETH Zurich. The next application window is open 1-30 November 2026 (11:59 MEZ) for a start in the Master programme in HS27.
desc: The Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) at ETH Zurich supports excellent Master's students with a scholarship, mentorship and a network of the ETH Foundation. The scholarship covers the full study and living costs during the Master's degree course. The next application window is open 1-30 November 2026 (11:59 MEZ) for a start in the Master programme in HS27.

title: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships
amount: CHF 10,000 per semester + guaranteed housing
eligible: Outstanding students beginning their Master's studies at EPFL, whether they obtained their Bachelor's degree at EPFL or at another institution, with remarkable academic results and distinguished extracurricular achievements (sporting, artistic, civic or entrepreneurial).
desc: EPFL offers a limited number of Master excellence fellowships, along with guaranteed housing, to the most outstanding students beginning their Master's studies. The fellowships are worth CHF 10,000 per semester and are available to students who obtained their Bachelor's degree at EPFL or at another institution. Candidates check the corresponding box on their Master's application form and provide the requested application file. Renewal for the second year requires at least 50 ECTS credits and an overall average of 5.0/6.

title: UPF-BSM Merit Based Scholarship
provider: UPF Barcelona School of Management (Universitat Pompeu Fabra)
amount: 25% of total tuition (up to +25% more in difficult economic situations)
eligible: Students applying to a master's programme at UPF Barcelona School of Management who can demonstrate talent, motivation and a university qualification. The percentage can be enlarged by up to an additional 25% if the candidate can prove a difficult economic situation. A minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 applies. Award is conditional on obtaining the degree by the start of the programme.
desc: The UPF Barcelona School of Management, through UPF's Institute of Continuing Education Foundation, annually awards the Merit Based Scholarship to finance master's studies of students who can demonstrate talent and motivation. The scholarship covers 25% of the total tuition fee, and the percentage may be enlarged by up to an additional 25% if candidates can prove a difficult economic situation. Requirements include a completed university qualification and, for those still pursuing a degree, maintaining the required grade point average (minimum 3.0/4.0).

title: UC3M Scholarships for University Master's Degrees
amount: Fixed amount of tuition fees
eligible: Students admitted to a university master's degree programme at Charles III University of Madrid (UC3M). Includes the School of Graduate Studies scholarship programme covering a fixed amount of tuition fees, the aid programme for research-oriented master's degrees (AEM_UC3M), and Santander-UC3M collaboration grants.
desc: Charles III University of Madrid (UC3M) offers several scholarship programmes to study a university master's degree, organised by the School of Graduate Studies: a scholarship programme covering a fixed amount of master's tuition fees, an aid programme for research-oriented master's degree programmes subject to specific objectives (call AEM_UC3M), and scholarship and study-grant programmes under the Santander-UC3M collaboration agreement. Calls for the 2026/27 academic year are published on the official page.

title: Waseda University Partial Tuition-Waiver Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students
amount: 50% of annual tuition
eligible: Privately financed international students with 'Student' visa status enrolled in a regular degree-seeking course at Waseda University. Government-sponsored students, exchange students and non-degree students are not eligible.
desc: Waseda University offers the Partial Tuition-Waiver Scholarship for Privately Financed International Students, covering 50% of annual tuition. It is available to privately financed international students with 'Student' visa status enrolled in a regular degree-seeking course. Waseda provides around 250 different scholarships in total, including about 150 for international students, across internal scholarships, external scholarships via university recommendation, and external open-recruitment scholarships.

title: Bilkent University Scholarships for International Students
amount: 20%–100% tuition waiver (in 20% increments); accommodation for top full-waiver students
duration: Up to 4 semesters in the English Preparatory Program and up to 10 semesters in 4-year programs
eligible: Prospective international students applying to Bilkent University who apply for financial assistance. Evaluated on high school grades, national and/or international exam scores, program choice and other academic criteria. Applicants who previously had or currently hold Turkish citizenship are not eligible. Scholarship continuation requires a minimum Annual-GPA of 2.00/4.00 and a minimum course load each semester.
desc: Bilkent University offers partial or full tuition waiver scholarships to qualified international applicants, awarded at five levels ranging from 20% to 100% in increments of 20%. A limited number of top students on full tuition waiver may also receive accommodation scholarships. Students must maintain a minimum Annual-GPA of 2.00/4.00 and take at least the minimum course load each semester to keep their scholarship. At the end of each academic year, top-performing international students (top 5% of non-scholarship students, GPA 3.30+) can be promoted to a merit scholarship covering 20%–100% of tuition depending on rank.

title: TOBB ETÜ Graduate Scholarship Programmes
provider: TOBB University of Economics and Technology
amount: Full Scholarship: tuition waiver + monthly living stipend (TRY 8,550/month deducted if using university guesthouse accommodation); Special Achievement: 150% of the full-scholarship stipend
duration: Duration of the degree programme (Master's tuition TRY 33,000; PhD TRY 38,000 for 2025–2026)
eligible: Applicants to the Graduate School of Engineering and Science programmes: Computer Engineering, Information Security, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, Architecture, Micro and Nano Technology. Full Scholarship includes a monthly living stipend or a partial stipend together with housing support. Special Achievement Scholarship requires ALES score 85/100, foreign language 75/100, and undergraduate GPA 3.00/4.00. English proficiency: only YDS, e-YDS, TOEFL iBT, YÖKDİL, or TOBB ETÜ English proficiency exams are accepted.
lang: TOEFL iBT accepted (other TOEFL formats not accepted)
desc: TOBB ETÜ's Graduate School of Engineering and Science offers several scholarship schemes for Master's and PhD students: a Full Scholarship covering tuition plus a monthly living stipend (or a partial stipend together with housing support); a Special Achievement Scholarship paying 150% of the full-scholarship stipend (requires ALES 85, foreign language 75, GPA 3.00); a Scientific Achievement Scholarship for students funded by TÜBİTAK-BİDEB or other officially recognised funding institutions (tuition-exempt); a Research Scholarship (full tuition waiver); and a Project Scholarship for students employed on externally funded research projects. For full-scholarship students choosing university guesthouse accommodation, TRY 8,550 is deducted from the stipend.

title: Koç University Merit Scholarships for International Students
amount: 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% tuition scholarship
duration: Regular period of the degree programme
eligible: Outstanding international candidates applying for undergraduate study at Koç University. All new international undergraduate candidates are automatically evaluated for a full or partial tuition-only scholarship based on academic merit.
desc: Koç University awards merit-based tuition scholarships of 25%, 50%, 75% or 100% to outstanding international undergraduate candidates. Every candidate is automatically evaluated for a scholarship when they fulfil the application requirements; no separate scholarship application is needed. Scholarships continue for the regular duration of the programme. Additional country-specific scholarships (e.g., Azerbaijan State Scholarship Program, Turkish Scholarships program) are also offered.

title: Anglo-Norse Society Scholarship at NTNU
provider: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
amount: £3,000 per year
eligible: British citizens admitted to a Master's degree at NTNU. No separate application required — the best qualified British citizen receiving admission is selected each year.
desc: The Anglo-Norse Society awards £3,000 each year to the best qualified British citizen receiving admission to a Master's degree at NTNU. No application is needed — eligible students are considered automatically upon admission. NTNU itself does not generally offer stipends or scholarships to international students, but lists this and other third-party funding opportunities for its students.

title: GSEP Scholarship for Sustainable Energy at NTNU
amount: Not specified on page (scholarship for outstanding Master's-level students from developing countries)
eligible: Outstanding Master's-level students from developing countries, in fields related to sustainable energy development, admitted to study at NTNU.
desc: The Global Sustainable Electricity Partnership (GSEP) offers scholarships for outstanding Master's-level students from developing countries in fields related to sustainable energy development, applicable to study at NTNU as listed on NTNU's official financing page. Check the GSEP website for current application details and amounts.

title: Tec de Monterrey Campus Monterrey Scholarships
amount: Tuition scholarships (need- and merit-based, e.g., Gallagher Foundation, Zaber Foundation, Domínguez-Rivas Fund, CEMYD housing)
eligible: Students at Campus Monterrey demonstrating academic excellence and/or high economic need. Examples: Gallagher Foundation supports young leaders from Mexico, South Africa and Turkey; Zaber Foundation supports students with high academic standards and high economic need; Domínguez-Rivas Fund grants tuition to INCQ (Nanotechnology and Chemical Sciences) students with high academic performance; CEMYD houses talented female students with economic constraints.
desc: Tecnológico de Monterrey Campus Monterrey offers a range of scholarships and financial aid programmes, including the Gallagher Foundation (young leaders with commitment to their country), Zaber Foundation (high academic standards and high economic need), the Domínguez-Rivas Scholarship Fund (tuition for high-performing INCQ Nanotechnology and Chemical Sciences students), CEMYD assistance houses (accommodation for talented female students with economic constraints) and the Ricardo Guajardo Brotherhood. Amounts and eligibility vary by programme; verify current details on the official page.

title: USP Graduate Scholarships in Probability and Statistics
provider: University of São Paulo (USP) — Institute of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science
amount: Master's: R$1,500/month; Doctoral: R$2,200/month (CNPq and CAPES)
duration: Master's up to 24 months; Doctorate up to 48 months
eligible: Best students with full dedication to the Graduate Program in Probability and Statistics at USP, selected on academic merit regardless of nationality. Foreign students from certain countries of Latin America, the Caribbean, Asia, Africa and Oceania may also apply for PEC-PG scholarships granted by Brazilian agencies from their home countries. FAPESP grants (higher values) are available via a project submitted by the student and tutor.
desc: The USP Institute of Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science offers CNPq and CAPES scholarships for its Graduate Program in Probability and Statistics, reserved for the best students with full dedication to the programme. Master's scholarships pay R$1,500/month for up to 24 months; doctoral scholarships pay R$2,200/month for up to 48 months. Scholarships are awarded on academic merit regardless of nationality. FAPESP grants with higher values are also available through a project submitted by the student and tutor. University of São Paulo graduate programmes are tuition-free.

title: UNICAMP GRE-FAPESP Direct Doctorate Scholarships
amount: FAPESP Direct Doctorate scholarship (30 available) for up to 60 months
eligible: Brazilian or foreign doctoral candidates admitted to UNICAMP postgraduate programmes graded 5, 6 or 7 in the latest CAPES assessment, selected through the GRE (Graduate Record Examination). The selection procedure is based on GRE scores, with the highest scores eligible for one of the 30 FAPESP scholarships. Programmes may additionally request specific tests, curriculum analysis or letters of recommendation. GRE exam fee: USD 205.
lang: GRE accepted as proof of English proficiency
desc: Since September 2020, UNICAMP has accepted the GRE as one of the selection stages for direct-admission doctorates in postgraduate programmes graded 5–7 by CAPES, in partnership with FAPESP. Successful students receive a FAPESP Direct Doctorate scholarship for up to 60 months; 30 scholarships are available. The selection is based on GRE scores, with the highest scorers eligible to apply for the scholarships. The GRE costs USD 205 and can be taken at more than 1,000 centres in 160 countries.

title: POSTECH International Student Scholarships
provider: POSTECH (Pohang University of Science and Technology)
amount: Full tuition + KRW 500,000/month living allowance + up to KRW 2,500,000 arrival support
duration: Full tuition for up to 8 semesters (standard enrollment period)
eligible: All admitted international students receive full tuition support upon enrollment. The living allowance (KRW 500,000/month, including vacation periods) has no GPA requirement. Korean Proficiency Scholarship (KRW 300,000 one-time) for international undergraduates with TOPIK level 4 or higher. Arrival Scholarship (up to KRW 2,500,000) reimburses one-way airfare and domestic transportation for students with no domestic residence within 6 months prior to admission.
desc: POSTECH offers full scholarships to all admitted international students: full tuition support for the standard enrollment period (up to 8 semesters), a KRW 500,000/month living allowance (no GPA requirement), a one-time KRW 300,000 Korean Proficiency Scholarship for undergraduates with TOPIK 4+, and an Arrival Scholarship reimbursing up to KRW 2,500,000 of travel costs for newly admitted students.

title: GIST International Graduate Scholarship
provider: GIST (Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology)
amount: Full tuition (KRW 3,607,000/semester) + stipend KRW 140,000-295,000/month + meal allowance ~KRW 100,000/month + research assistantship KRW 6,400,000-13,740,000/year
eligible: All international graduate students at GIST are granted the GIST scholarship without a separate application. Includes full tuition support, monthly student allowance (140,000 won/month for M.S., 295,000 won/month for Ph.D.), a ~100,000 won/month meal allowance, research assistantships (average 6,400,000 won/year M.S., 13,740,000 won/year Ph.D.), 60% national health insurance support, and one-way flight reimbursement for incoming international students.
desc: All international graduate students at GIST receive the GIST scholarship automatically (no separate application): full tuition (KRW 3,607,000/semester), monthly student allowance of KRW 140,000 (M.S.) or 295,000 (Ph.D.), meal allowance of about KRW 100,000/month, research assistantships averaging KRW 6,400,000-13,740,000 per year, 60% national health insurance support and a one-way flight reimbursement.

title: SKKU International Student Scholarships
amount: 10-100% of tuition (incl. entrance fee) for the first semester
eligible: Undergraduate: applicants are automatically selected based on admission evaluation results (separate application not required); amount is 10-100% of dues including the entrance fee, awarded for the first semester only. Graduate: international students accepted to Humanities, Social Sciences and Art departments are selected based on admission evaluation; amount is 100%, 70%, 50%, 25% or 10% of admission fee and tuition for the first semester.
desc: SKKU awards admission scholarships to international students based automatically on their admission evaluation: undergraduates receive 10-100% of dues (including the entrance fee) for the first semester, and graduate students in Humanities, Social Sciences and Art departments receive 100%, 70%, 50%, 25% or 10% of the admission fee and tuition for the first semester. No separate scholarship application is required.

title: Hanyang International Excellence Awards (HIEA)
amount: 70%, 50% or 30% tuition reduction for one semester
eligible: International students (foreign students) with a TOPIK level certificate and a minimum GPA of 3.0 for the previous semester. Students receiving other scholarships from other organizations (including GKS) cannot apply. Extra points are given depending on the TOPIK level. Requires valid insurance for the application period.
lang: TOPIK (Korean) certificate required; English-track programmes may accept IELTS/TOEFL
desc: The Hanyang International Excellence Awards give international students a 70%, 50% or 30% tuition reduction for one semester based on evaluation. Applicants need a TOPIK level certificate and a minimum GPA of 3.0 from the previous semester; applications open at the beginning of March and September each year with interviews in mid-March and mid-September.

title: Ewha GSIS Scholarships (Graduate School of International Studies)
amount: Half tuition (incl. entrance fee); work-based scholarships of KRW 2,000,000-4,000,000
eligible: Merit-based: half tuition (including entrance fee) for incoming students based on admission rank and for current full-time students; no application required. Work-based: KOICA-Sun scholarship (half tuition, working 10 hours/week at GSIS offices), Ewha Working Scholarship A (KRW 4,000,000, 14 hours/week) and B (KRW 2,000,000, 7 hours/week), and research assistantships (full or half tuition).
desc: Ewha GSIS offers semester-based scholarships for its English-taught Master's programmes: a merit-based scholarship of half tuition (including entrance fee) awarded by admission rank with no application required, plus work-based scholarships (KOICA-Sun half tuition for 10h/week; Ewha A KRW 4,000,000 for 14h/week; Ewha B KRW 2,000,000 for 7h/week) and research assistantships covering full or half tuition.

title: Sophia University Tuition Support Scholarship
amount: Full, one-half or one-third of the tuition fee
duration: Scholarship period per university terms (typically one academic year)
eligible: Students facing financial hardship that makes it difficult to continue their studies despite strong motivation. No repayment required.
lang: Most programmes taught in Japanese; English-taught programmes available
desc: Sophia University's Tuition Support Scholarship is a non-repayable grant covering the full, one-half, or one-third of the tuition fee for students facing financial hardship. The same page also lists the JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for privately-financed international students (48,000 yen/month, FY2025 rate) and external private-organization scholarships.

title: Tohoku University JASSO Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students
amount: 48,000 yen per month (JASSO Honors Scholarship rate)
duration: Monthly while enrolled (typically 1 year, renewable per JASSO rules)
eligible: Self-financed (privately-financed) international students with excellent grades who need financial assistance to continue their studies. Selection is by the university (reservation through Tohoku University for pre-arrival admission).
lang: Programmes taught in English or Japanese
desc: Tohoku University's financial-support page lists the JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for privately-financed international students (48,000 yen/month), the Tohoku University International Excellence Scholarship, MEXT scholarships (university or embassy recommendation; monthly stipends of about 119,000-147,000 yen depending on level) and private foundation scholarships.

title: Kobe University Tuition Fee Exemption
amount: Full or half tuition fee exemption
eligible: Students who have difficulty paying the tuition fee due to specified circumstances (e.g. financial hardship) may be granted a full or half tuition exemption. Available to regular undergraduate and graduate students, including privately-financed international students.
lang: Programmes taught in English or Japanese
desc: Kobe University maintains a Tuition Fee Exemption programme granting a full or half exemption of the tuition fee to students facing financial difficulty, alongside scholarships for privately-financed international students and the admission-fee exemption/deferral programme.

title: Kyushu University JASSO Scholarship for Exchange Students
amount: 80,000 yen per month
duration: Period of enrollment in the exchange programme (up to one year)
eligible: Exchange students coming to Kyushu University from overseas partner universities. Application is made through Kyushu University together with the Student Exchange Program application.
desc: Kyushu University's financial aid page covers the JASSO Student Exchange Support Program scholarship (80,000 yen/month) for exchange students from partner universities, scholarships for self-supporting international students, and Kyushu University Fund grants (Yamakawa Prize and Grant, grants for unique studies, international conference participation and research activities).

title: USI Merit Scholarships (Foundation for the Lugano Faculties)
amount: CHF 4,000 scholarship to the best enrolled students
eligible: Best students enrolled at USI, selected on academic merit (28 scholarships were awarded in 2025).
desc: USI awards CHF 4,000 scholarships to the best enrolled students through the Foundation for the Lugano Faculties (28 scholarships worth CHF 112,000 were awarded in 2025). Tuition at USI is CHF 4,000 per semester for international students at Bachelor/Master level.

title: University of Basel Final-Phase Partial Scholarships
amount: CHF 200-600 per month (university funds); CHF 500-1,000 per semester (student Solidarity Fund)
eligible: Students completing the final phase of a Bachelor's or Master's degree who face financial difficulties. The Solidarity Fund (Solifonds) is administered by the student body.
desc: The University of Basel funds partial scholarships of CHF 200-600 per person per month during the final degree phase (BA/MA), plus the student-body Solidarity Fund (CHF 500-1,000 per semester), the Legat Grobe fund for biology students (CHF 200-600/month) and medical funds for Swiss-citizen medical students.

title: HSG Excellence Scholarships
amount: 42 scholarships worth over CHF 450,000 (2024), covering tuition fees
eligible: Outstanding students at Bachelor's and Master's level; the HSG Best Talents Programme targets outstanding Bachelor's graduates (EU/EFTA nationals or holders of a Swiss degree). Social scholarships are available for students with financial difficulties.
desc: HSG awards excellence scholarships funded by its community (42 scholarships worth over CHF 450,000 in 2024) that cover tuition fees, alongside social scholarships for students with financial difficulties and the HSG Best Talents Programme for outstanding Bachelor's graduates.

title: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships (hosted at University of Zurich)
amount: Tuition fees waived + monthly stipend set by the Federal Commission for Scholarships + CHF 300 one-time payment + health insurance premiums for non-EU/EFTA holders
duration: Per scholarship award (PhD / postdoctoral research stay)
eligible: Foreign postgraduate researchers with at least a Master's degree who wish to pursue PhD studies or postdoctoral research in Switzerland. Valid at all Swiss cantonal universities, universities of applied sciences and the two federal institutes of technology.
desc: The Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships, administered by the Federal Commission for Scholarships (FCS) and hosted at UZH and all Swiss universities, cover PhD and postdoctoral research stays: tuition fees are waived, recipients receive a monthly stipend, a one-time CHF 300 payment, and health-insurance premiums for non-EU/EFTA scholarship holders are paid.

title: IESE MBA Scholarships
amount: Individual scholarships typically 10-50% of tuition fees
eligible: MBA candidates (including international candidates) selected on merit and financial need. Specific pools exist for women (e.g. Forte Fellowship), candidates from developing/emerging markets and candidates with dependent family members. Living expenses are not covered.
desc: IESE offers merit- and need-based scholarships for its Full-Time MBA, typically covering 10-50% of tuition, with specific pools for women, candidates from emerging markets and those with family responsibilities. Candidates submit one scholarship essay with the MBA application; scholarship decisions follow admission.

title: ESADE Degree Talent Scholarships
amount: 60-100% of tuition fees for the entire programme
eligible: Students with outstanding academic records whose financial situation may be an obstacle. Types: Dedicated Talent Scholarships (company-named), Future Talent Scholarships (donor-created) and others; some grants also support room and board.
desc: ESADE's Talent Scholarships cover 60-100% of tuition for the entire undergraduate or double-degree programme for academically outstanding students with financial need, with grants also available for room and board (the programme awarded 295 scholarships in the latest cohort, covering 84% of recipients' tuition).

title: ESADE MSc Scholarships
amount: 50-85% of the MSc tuition fee
eligible: Open to all applicants to ESADE Master of Science programmes; awarded on merit, with a limited number of scholarships available.
desc: ESADE's MSc Scholarship Program is open to all applicants and covers 50-85% of the MSc tuition fee for a limited number of scholarships, alongside income-share agreements and financial-aid options.

title: UV-AUIP Scholarships for Master's Studies
amount: 12 scholarships (8 new + 4 renewals) for official Master's programmes
duration: One academic year (renewable for programmes over 60 ECTS)
eligible: Graduates of a Latin American university that is an AUIP member institution. Must be a new student at the University of Valencia, not have resided in Spain for more than 12 months in the previous 3 years, have a minimum grade point average of 8 (on a 10-point scale) and meet the admission requirements of the chosen official Master's programme. Application window for the 2026-27 call: 1-24 April 2026.
desc: The University of Valencia, with the Association of Ibero-American Postgraduate Universities (AUIP), offers 12 scholarships (8 new awards + 4 renewals) for students from AUIP-member Latin American universities to pursue official Master's programmes at UV. Requirements include a minimum GPA of 8/10, AUIP-member institution graduation and non-residence in Spain for over 12 months in the preceding 3 years.

title: Sabancı University Graduate Scholarships
amount: 100% tuition exemption + monthly stipend (PhD: 115,000-135,000 TL for 12 months) + free dormitory room
duration: Standard graduate program duration (2026-2027 academic year)
eligible: Students admitted to Sabancı University academic graduate programs (except professional graduate programs) receive full exemption from annual tuition fees; most also receive a monthly stipend and free dormitory room. The Distinguished Science and Technology Scholarship is awarded to exceptionally successful PhD candidates in the Graduate School of Engineering and Natural Sciences, including co-supervision and joint PhD opportunities. Admission and scholarship decisions are made on academic merit during the evaluation process.
desc: All students admitted to Sabancı University academic graduate programmes receive 100% tuition exemption; most also receive a monthly stipend and a free dormitory room. PhD candidates in Engineering and Natural Sciences may receive the Distinguished Science and Technology Scholarship (stipend of 115,000-135,000 TL over 12 months) with co-supervision and joint-degree opportunities.

title: Sabancı University International Undergraduate Admission Scholarships
amount: 25%, 40%, 50%, 75% or 100% tuition waivers
eligible: Every international candidate who applies to Sabancı University is evaluated automatically for an admission scholarship when they fulfill the application requirements; scholarships are limited and competition is keen, so certain scores do not guarantee specific levels.
desc: Sabancı University offers admission scholarships to international undergraduate candidates as tuition waivers covering 25%, 40%, 50%, 75% or 100% of tuition. Every international applicant is evaluated automatically for a scholarship when they fulfill the application requirements.
